annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same core evidence: they favor an immediate refund based on the customer’s report, defer verification of the purchase record to later, and treat policy or record issues as follow-up matters rather than prerequisites. None of the responses adds a materially different safeguard, escalation trigger, or authorization limit that would change the criterion-level assessment; they all show a similar willingness to act before full information is available, with escalation only if the customer objects or there is a later issue.
